text:
maria: quick thought — during the telemetry sampling preview rollout i'm seeing a lot of saved-query churn. folks edit per-route filters to try different sample rates and then overwrite shared saved queries. can we add an 'undo' or lightweight version history to the console so rolling back is easy? cc @jon @alyssa

jon: yeah this is painful. we currently overwrite without guard. modal confirm was proposed but adds friction. maybe inline undo/toast is better :thinking:

sam: server-side history (last N edits) + client "undo" that triggers a rollback API seems safest. keeps shared queries recoverable. small question: how big are these saved query blobs? storage impact?

alyssa: proposal: keep last 5 versions per saved_query with meta: editor, ts, change_summary. show diff view and an "undo last change" action in the save toast. no heavy snapshots.

maria: +1. telemetry events we need: saved_query.edit (with change_delta_size, sample_rate, model_pin), saved_query.rollback (from_version_id). also include route_id in events for per-route metrics.

lucas: backend ok with storing small deltas. API sketch:

PUT /api/v1/saved_queries/:id
{
  "name": "string",
  "filters": [ ... ],
  "create_history": true
}

server will respond with new_version_id and previous_version_id.

jon: about quotas — do we count history bytes toward saved-query quota? we should. orgs might hit storage limits.

sam: add org-level toggle and retention policy (history_enabled: boolean, history_retention_days: int)

maria: security note — for private deployments we need an admin opt-out to avoid retaining query content. add admin disable flag.

ops-bot: reminder: add policy docs entry and migration plan. ops will need a flag to purge historical entries for compliance.

alyssa: UX followups: (1) save toast has "undo" for 30s, (2) history drawer for last 5 versions, (3) diff highlights. i'll mock quick in Figma and drop link.

maria: thanks — let's aim for small MVP: toast undo + server-side 5-version retention + telemetry. i'll create a ticket and assign engineers.

jon: sounds good. will estimate effort once ticket lands.

maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
